records.title: Portable context layer
records.explanation: Keep indexed business files between models and applications; distinguish stored knowledge from the runtime that executes work.

records.title: Decision cycle
records.explanation: Observe data, interpret its meaning, decide and act; use the resulting observations to continue the cycle.

records.title: Human bridge first
records.explanation: The creator recommends human decisions between analysis and execution until business knowledge is sufficiently developed.

records.title: Separate execution engine
records.explanation: The creator favours self-hosted n8n for triggered, multi-step actions rather than expecting the knowledge folder to execute everything.

records.title: Secret aliases
records.explanation: Store readable secret names in context and actual values in a vault; resolve aliases during execution. Claimed protection needs verification.

records.title: Database references
records.explanation: Keep large numerical datasets in databases and record their locations and retrieval instructions in the brain.

records.title: Creator ecosystem
records.explanation: Infinity OS, a foundation and related commercial services are presented as the creators’ ecosystem, with availability and productivity claims unverified.

records.title: Model ranking
records.explanation: The asserted model superiority and benchmark comparisons are creator claims, not validated evidence in this database.

records.title: Model-independent files
records.explanation: Store business knowledge and work history in files so another compatible model can use the same context.

records.title: Typed relationships
records.explanation: Label note links with their meaning, including dependency, contradiction and derivation, rather than recording connection alone.

records.title: Connect surrounding tools
records.explanation: Add execution, history, messaging, agent management and secret storage around the knowledge layer.

records.title: Query live numbers
records.explanation: Reference the operational database instead of copying all changing numerical data into knowledge files.

records.title: Starter system and swarm
records.explanation: The creator promotes a starter brain and describes large agent swarms; reliability, access and scale are unverified.

records.title: Explain relationships
records.explanation: Record how notes support, derive from or depend on other notes so retrieval includes the relevant reasoning context.

records.title: Review shared improvements
records.explanation: Keep individual knowledge separate; submit reusable rules and workflows for managerial approval before distributing them.

records.title: Session records
records.explanation: Save compact dated work summaries, goals and model details for later retrieval rather than relying on active chat history.

records.title: Indexed tool access

records.title: Weekly analysis and prototypes

records.title: Demonstration data

records.title: Direct knowledge deliberately
